types.name: SyncService
types.doc:
<summary>
Sincroniza las tareas entre SQLite (la fuente de verdad local) y Supabase,
la tabla "tarea" que comparte con Proyectito.

El orden importa: primero se sube lo que el usuario hizo en esta app y
después se baja lo que cambió en el otro lado. Así, un cambio hecho en
Proyectito (completar, editar, borrar) aparece en Asistente, y al revés.

Reglas de conflicto, ya que la tabla no lleva marca de tiempo:
  - Si la fila local tiene cambios sin enviar (IsSynced = false), manda el
    cambio local y la fila no se sobrescribe al bajar del servidor.
  - Si la fila local ya está sincronizada, manda el servidor.
  - Los borrados locales se propagan al servidor y se limpian de SQLite.
  - Las filas que el servidor ya no tiene (borradas en otro dispositivo)
    se borran también de SQLite.
</summary>

<ContentPage xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
             x:Class="Asistente.AdminDetallePage"
             BackgroundColor="#0B1120"
             NavigationPage.HasNavigationBar="False"
             Shell.NavBarIsVisible="False">

    <Grid RowDefinitions="Auto,Auto,*,Auto" RowSpacing="12">

        <!-- Cabecera con la ficha de la cuenta -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="0"
              ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*,Auto"
              ColumnSpacing="12"
              Padding="20,20,20,0">

            <Button Grid.Column="0"
                    Text="‹"
                    FontSize="24"
                    BackgroundColor="#111C30"
                    BorderColor="#245B78"
                    BorderWidth="1"
                    TextColor="#22D3EE"
                    WidthRequest="46"
                    HeightRequest="46"
                    Padding="0,0"
                    CornerRadius="23"
                    VerticalOptions="Center"
                    Clicked="OnVolverClicked"
                    ToolTipProperties.Text="Volver" />

            <Border Grid.Column="1"
                    WidthRequest="46"
                    HeightRequest="46"
                    StrokeThickness="0"
                    BackgroundColor="#1E3A5F"
                    VerticalOptions="Center">
                <Border.StrokeShape>
                    <RoundRectangle CornerRadius="23" />
                </Border.StrokeShape>
                <Label x:Name="LblInicialesDet"
                       Text="?"
                       TextColor="#E2E8F0"
                       FontSize="15"
                       FontAttributes="Bold"
                       HorizontalOptions="Center"
                       VerticalOptions="Center" />
            </Border>

            <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="2" Spacing="2" VerticalOptions="Center">
                <Label x:Name="LblNombreDet"
                       Text="Cuenta"
                       TextColor="#E2E8F0"
                       FontSize="18"
                       FontAttributes="Bold"
                       LineBreakMode="TailTruncation" />
                <HorizontalStackLayout Spacing="8">
                    <Label x:Name="LblCorreoDet"
                           Text=""
                           TextColor="#64748B"
                           FontSize="12"
                           LineBreakMode="TailTruncation" />
                    <Border x:Name="BordeRol"
                            Padding="7,2"
                            StrokeThickness="0"
                            BackgroundColor="#1E3A5F">
                        <Border.StrokeShape>
                            <RoundRectangle CornerRadius="10" />
                        </Border.StrokeShape>
                        <Label x:Name="LblRolDet"
                               Text="Usuario"
                               TextColor="#E2E8F0"
                               FontSize="10"
                               FontAttributes="Bold"
                               VerticalOptions="Center" />
                    </Border>
                </HorizontalStackLayout>
            </VerticalStackLayout>
        </Grid>

        <!-- Acciones de la cuenta -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="1"
              ColumnDefinitions="*,*,*"
              ColumnSpacing="8"
              Margin="20,0">

            <Button Grid.Column="0"
                    Text="✎ Nombre"
                    FontSize="12"
                    BackgroundColor="#111C30"
                    BorderColor="#245B78"
                    BorderWidth="1"
                    TextColor="#38BDF8"
                    CornerRadius="8"
                    Clicked="OnEditarNombreClicked" />

            <Button x:Name="BtnCambiarRol"
                    Grid.Column="1"
                    Text="★ Rol"
                    FontSize="12"
                    BackgroundColor="#111C30"
                    BorderColor="#245B78"
                    BorderWidth="1"
                    TextColor="#FBBF24"
                    CornerRadius="8"
                    Clicked="OnCambiarRolClicked" />

            <Button Grid.Column="2"
                    Text="🗑 Cuenta"
                    FontSize="12"
                    BackgroundColor="#450A0A"
                    BorderColor="#F87171"
                    BorderWidth="1"
                    TextColor="#F87171"
                    CornerRadius="8"
                    Clicked="OnEliminarCuentaClicked" />
        </Grid>

        <!-- Tareas de la cuenta -->
        <ScrollView Grid.Row="2" Margin="20,0">
            <VerticalStackLayout x:Name="Contenido" Spacing="8" Padding="0,0,0,10" />
        </ScrollView>

        <!-- Agregar tarea -->
        <Button Grid.Row="3"
                x:Name="BtnAgregar"
                Text="＋ Agregar tarea"

                TextColor="#E2E8F0"
                FontAttributes="Bold"
                CornerRadius="8"
                Clicked="OnAgregarClicked" />

        <ActivityIndicator x:Name="Indicador"

    </Grid>

<ContentPage xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
             x:Class="Asistente.AdminPage"
             BackgroundColor="#0B1120"
             NavigationPage.HasNavigationBar="False"
             Shell.NavBarIsVisible="False">

    <Grid RowDefinitions="Auto,Auto,Auto,*" RowSpacing="14">

        <!-- Cabecera -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="0"
              ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*,Auto"
              ColumnSpacing="12"
              Padding="20,20,20,0">

            <Button Grid.Column="0"
                    Text="SALIR"
                    FontSize="13"
                    FontAttributes="Bold"
                    BackgroundColor="#450A0A"
                    BorderColor="#F87171"
                    BorderWidth="1"
                    TextColor="#F87171"
                    WidthRequest="58"
                    HeightRequest="42"
                    Padding="0,0"
                    CornerRadius="21"
                    VerticalOptions="Center"
                    Clicked="OnSalirClicked"
                    ToolTipProperties.Text="Cerrar sesión" />

            <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" Spacing="2" VerticalOptions="Center">
                <Label Text="Panel de administración"
                       FontSize="22"
                       FontAttributes="Bold"
                       TextColor="#E2E8F0" />
                <Label x:Name="LblSubtitulo"
                       Text="Cargando cuentas..."
                       FontSize="13"
                       TextColor="#64748B"
                       LineBreakMode="TailTruncation" />
            </VerticalStackLayout>

            <Button Grid.Column="2"
                    Text="⟳"
                    FontSize="20"
                    BackgroundColor="#111C30"
                    BorderColor="#245B78"
                    BorderWidth="1"
                    TextColor="#E2E8F0"
                    WidthRequest="46"
                    HeightRequest="46"
                    Padding="0,0"
                    CornerRadius="23"
                    VerticalOptions="Center"
                    Clicked="OnRefrescarClicked"
                    ToolTipProperties.Text="Actualizar" />
        </Grid>

        <!-- Aviso de conexión -->
        <Border Grid.Row="1"
                x:Name="AvisoOffline"
                IsVisible="False"
                Margin="20,0"
                Padding="12"
                BackgroundColor="#1C120D"
                Stroke="#F59E0B"
                StrokeThickness="1">
            <Border.StrokeShape>
                <RoundRectangle CornerRadius="10" />
            </Border.StrokeShape>
            <Label Text="Sin conexión: el panel de administración necesita internet para hablar con el servidor."
                   FontSize="12"
                   TextColor="#FBBF24"
                   LineBreakMode="WordWrap" />
        </Border>

        <!-- Buscador -->
        <Border Grid.Row="2"
                Margin="20,0"
                Padding="12,0,12,0"
                HeightRequest="46"
                BackgroundColor="#111C30"
                Stroke="#245B78"
                StrokeThickness="1">
            <Border.StrokeShape>
                <RoundRectangle CornerRadius="12" />
            </Border.StrokeShape>
            <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*" ColumnSpacing="8">
                <Label Text="🔍" FontSize="14" VerticalOptions="Center" />
                <Entry x:Name="TxtBuscar"
                       Grid.Column="1"
                       Placeholder="Buscar por nombre o correo..."
                       PlaceholderColor="#64748B"
                       BackgroundColor="Transparent"
                       TextColor="#E2E8F0"
                       VerticalOptions="Center"
                       TextChanged="OnBuscarChanged" />
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- Lista de cuentas -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="3">
            <CollectionView x:Name="ListaUsuarios"
                            SelectionMode="Single"
                            SelectionChanged="OnUsuarioSeleccionado"
                            Margin="20,0,20,10">
                <CollectionView.ItemTemplate>
                    <DataTemplate>
                        <Frame Margin="0,4"
                               Padding="14"
                               CornerRadius="14"
                               BackgroundColor="#111827"
                               BorderColor="#245B78"
                               HasShadow="False">
                            <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,*,Auto" ColumnSpacing="12">

                                <Border Grid.Column="0"
                                        WidthRequest="44"
                                        HeightRequest="44"
                                        StrokeThickness="0"
                                        BackgroundColor="{Binding BadgeColor}"
                                        VerticalOptions="Center">
                                    <Border.StrokeShape>
                                        <RoundRectangle CornerRadius="22" />
                                    </Border.StrokeShape>
                                    <Label Text="{Binding Iniciales}"
                                           TextColor="#E2E8F0"
                                           FontSize="14"
                                           FontAttributes="Bold"
                                           HorizontalOptions="Center"
                                           VerticalOptions="Center" />
                                </Border>

                                <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1" Spacing="3" VerticalOptions="Center">
                                    <Label Text="{Binding Nombre}"
                                           TextColor="#E2E8F0"
                                           FontSize="16"
                                           FontAttributes="Bold"
                                           LineBreakMode="TailTruncation" />
                                    <Label Text="{Binding Correo}"
                                           TextColor="#64748B"
                                           FontSize="13"
                                           LineBreakMode="TailTruncation" />
                                </VerticalStackLayout>

                                <Grid Grid.Column="2"
                                      ColumnDefinitions="Auto,Auto"
                                      ColumnSpacing="6"
                                      VerticalOptions="Center">
                                    <Border Padding="8,3"
                                            StrokeThickness="0"
                                            BackgroundColor="{Binding BadgeColor}">
                                        <Border.StrokeShape>
                                            <RoundRectangle CornerRadius="12" />
                                        </Border.StrokeShape>
                                        <Label Text="{Binding DescripcionRol}"
                                               TextColor="#E2E8F0"
                                               FontSize="11"
                                               FontAttributes="Bold"
                                               VerticalOptions="Center" />
                                    </Border>
                                    <Label Grid.Column="1"
                                           Text="›"
                                           FontSize="22"
                                           TextColor="#64748B"
                                           VerticalOptions="Center" />
                                </Grid>

                            </Grid>
                        </Frame>
                    </DataTemplate>
                </CollectionView.ItemTemplate>
            </CollectionView>

            <Label x:Name="LblVacio"
                   Text="No se encontraron cuentas."
                   TextColor="#64748B"
                   FontSize="14"
                   HorizontalOptions="Center"
                   VerticalOptions="Center"
                   IsVisible="False" />

            <ActivityIndicator x:Name="Indicador"
                               Grid.Row="3"
                               Color="#22D3EE"
                               IsVisible="False"
                               IsRunning="False"
                               VerticalOptions="Center"
                               HorizontalOptions="Center" />
        </Grid>

    </Grid>
</ContentPage>

<ContentPage xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
             x:Class="Asistente.MainPage"
             BackgroundColor="#0B1120"
             NavigationPage.HasNavigationBar="False"
             Shell.NavBarIsVisible="False">

    <Grid>

        <!-- ========================================= -->
        <!-- CONTENIDO PRINCIPAL                       -->
        <!-- ========================================= -->

        <Grid RowDefinitions="Auto, Auto, *, Auto"
              Padding="20"
              RowSpacing="15">

            <!-- 1. NÚCLEO TECNOLÓGICO Y ANILLOS HUD -->
            <Grid Grid.Row="0"
                  HeightRequest="220"
                  WidthRequest="220"
                  HorizontalOptions="Center"
                  VerticalOptions="Center">

                <!-- Glow -->
                <Ellipse x:Name="GlowEffect"
                         WidthRequest="160"
                         HeightRequest="160"
                         Fill="#22D3EE"
                         Opacity="0.15"
                         HorizontalOptions="Center"
                         VerticalOptions="Center" />

                <!-- Anillo exterior -->
                <Ellipse x:Name="OuterRing1"
                         WidthRequest="210"
                         HeightRequest="210"
                         Stroke="#22D3EE"
                         StrokeThickness="1.5"
                         StrokeDashArray="12, 6, 2, 6"
                         HorizontalOptions="Center"
                         VerticalOptions="Center" />

                <!-- Segundo anillo -->
                <Ellipse x:Name="OuterRing2"
                         WidthRequest="180"
                         HeightRequest="180"
                         Stroke="#164E63"
                         StrokeThickness="2"
                         StrokeDashArray="1, 8, 20, 5"
                         HorizontalOptions="Center"
                         VerticalOptions="Center" />

                <!-- Anillo medio -->
                <Ellipse x:Name="MidRing"
                         WidthRequest="140"
                         HeightRequest="140"
                         Stroke="#22D3EE"
                         StrokeThickness="3"
                         StrokeDashArray="4, 12"
                         HorizontalOptions="Center"
                         VerticalOptions="Center" />

                <!-- Anillo interior -->
                <Ellipse x:Name="InnerRing"
                         WidthRequest="100"
                         HeightRequest="100"
                         Stroke="#38BDF8"
                         StrokeThickness="1"
                         StrokeDashArray="2, 3"
                         HorizontalOptions="Center"
                         VerticalOptions="Center" />

                <!-- Núcleo -->
                <Border x:Name="CoreCenter"
                        WidthRequest="60"
                        HeightRequest="60"
                        HorizontalOptions="Center"
                        VerticalOptions="Center"
                        StrokeThickness="0">

                    <Border.StrokeShape>
                        <RoundRectangle CornerRadius="30"/>
                    </Border.StrokeShape>

                    <Border.Background>
                        <RadialGradientBrush Center="0.5,0.5"
                                             Radius="0.5">

                            <GradientStop Color="#E0F2FE"
                                          Offset="0.0" />

                            <GradientStop Color="#38BDF8"
                                          Offset="0.4" />

                            <GradientStop Color="#2563EB"
                                          Offset="0.8" />

                            <GradientStop Color="Transparent"
                                          Offset="1.0" />

                        </RadialGradientBrush>
                    </Border.Background>

                </Border>

                <!-- Esquinas HUD -->
                <Path Data="M 0,20 L 0,0 L 20,0
                            M 200,0 L 220,0 L 220,20
                            M 220,200 L 220,220 L 200,220
                            M 0,200 L 0,220 L 20,220"
                      Stroke="#22D3EE"
                      StrokeThickness="1.5"
                      Opacity="0.5"
                      HorizontalOptions="Fill"
                      VerticalOptions="Fill"/>

            </Grid>


            <!-- ========================================= -->
            <!-- 2. MENSAJE DEL ASISTENTE                   -->
            <!-- ========================================= -->

            <Frame Grid.Row="1"
                   BackgroundColor="#111C30"
                   BorderColor="#22D3EE"
                   CornerRadius="12"
                   HasShadow="False"
                   Padding="15">

                <Label x:Name="AiMessageLabel"
                       Text="Núcleo activado. Sincronizando datos con el servidor..."
                       FontSize="18"
                       TextColor="#E2E8F0"
                       FontFamily="Arial"
                       FontAttributes="Bold"
                       HorizontalTextAlignment="Center"/>

            </Frame>


            <!-- ========================================= -->
            <!-- 3. LISTA DE TAREAS (PENDIENTES | COMPLETADAS) -->
            <!-- ========================================= -->

            <Grid Grid.Row="2"
                  RowDefinitions="Auto, Auto, *"
                  RowSpacing="8">

                <!-- BOTONES DE FILTRO -->
                <Grid Grid.Row="0"
                      ColumnDefinitions="*, *"
                      ColumnSpacing="12">

                    <Button x:Name="BtnFiltroPendientes"
                            Grid.Column="0"
                            Text="Pendientes (0)"
                            Clicked="OnFiltroPendientesClicked"
                            BackgroundColor="#0E7490"
                            BorderColor="#67E8F9"
                            BorderWidth="2"
                            TextColor="#FFFFFF"
                            FontAttributes="Bold"
                            FontSize="14"
                            HeightRequest="46"
                            CornerRadius="23"
                            Padding="0,0">
                        <Button.Shadow>
                            <Shadow x:Name="ShadowPendientes"
                                    Brush="#67E8F9"
                                    Opacity="0.5"
                                    Radius="14"
                                    Offset="0,0"/>
                        </Button.Shadow>
                    </Button>

                    <Button x:Name="BtnFiltroCompletadas"
                            Grid.Column="1"
                            Text="Completadas (0)"
                            Clicked="OnFiltroCompletadasClicked"
                            BackgroundColor="#111C30"
                            BorderColor="#245B78"
                            BorderWidth="1"
                            TextColor="#94A3B8"
                            FontSize="14"
                            HeightRequest="46"
                            CornerRadius="23"
                            Padding="0,0">
                        <Button.Shadow>
                            <Shadow x:Name="ShadowCompletadas"
                                    Brush="#6EE7B7"
                                    Opacity="0"
                                    Radius="14"
                                    Offset="0,0"/>
                        </Button.Shadow>
                    </Button>

                </Grid>

                <!-- CONTADOR -->
                <Label x:Name="TareasCountLabel"
                       Grid.Row="1"
                       Text="Mostrando: Pendientes"
                       FontSize="12"
                       TextColor="#64748B"
                       HorizontalOptions="Center"/>

                <!-- COLLECTIONVIEW ÚNICO -->
                <CollectionView x:Name="TasksCollectionView"
                                Grid.Row="2"
                                SelectionMode="Single"
                                SelectionChanged="OnTaskTapped">

                    <CollectionView.EmptyView>
                        <Label x:Name="EmptyViewLabel"
                               Text="Sin tareas pendientes"
                               FontSize="13"
                               TextColor="#64748B"
                               HorizontalTextAlignment="Center"
                               Margin="0,20"/>
                    </CollectionView.EmptyView>

                    <CollectionView.ItemTemplate>

                        <DataTemplate>

                            <Frame Margin="0,4"
                                   Padding="12"
                                   CornerRadius="8"
                                   BackgroundColor="#111827"
                                   BorderColor="#245B78">

                                <Grid ColumnDefinitions="*, Auto">

                                    <!-- Información de tarea -->
                                    <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="0"
                                                         Spacing="3">

                                        <Label Text="{Binding Titulo}"
                                               FontAttributes="Bold"
                                               FontSize="15"
                                               TextColor="#E2E8F0"/>

                                        <Label Text="{Binding FechaVencimiento, StringFormat='Vence: {0:dd/MM/yyyy}'}"
                                               FontSize="11"
                                               TextColor="#64748B"/>

                                        <Label Text="{Binding FrecuenciaRecordatorioHoras, StringFormat='Recordar cada {0} horas', TargetNullValue='Sin recordatorio'}"
                                               FontSize="10"
                                               TextColor="#E2E8F0"/>

                                    </VerticalStackLayout>

                                    <!-- ============================= -->
                                    <!-- BOTONES CRUD                   -->
                                    <!-- ============================= -->

                                    <VerticalStackLayout Grid.Column="1"
                                                         Spacing="6">

                                        <!-- Completar / Reabrir -->
                                        <Button Text="Completar"
                                                Clicked="OnToggleCompleteClicked"
                                                BackgroundColor="#172554"
                                                BorderColor="#22D3EE"

<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

	<PropertyGroup>
		<TargetFrameworks>net10.0-android</TargetFrameworks>
		<TargetFrameworks Condition="!$([MSBuild]::IsOSPlatform('linux'))">$(TargetFrameworks);net10.0-ios;net10.0-maccatalyst</TargetFrameworks>
		<TargetFrameworks Condition="$([MSBuild]::IsOSPlatform('windows'))">$(TargetFrameworks);net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0</TargetFrameworks>

		<!-- Note for MacCatalyst:
		The default runtime is maccatalyst-x64, except in Release config, in which case the default is maccatalyst-x64;maccatalyst-arm64.
		When specifying both architectures, use the plural <RuntimeIdentifiers> instead of the singular <RuntimeIdentifier>.
		The Mac App Store will NOT accept apps with ONLY maccatalyst-arm64 indicated;
		either BOTH runtimes must be indicated or ONLY macatalyst-x64. -->
		<!-- For example: <RuntimeIdentifiers>maccatalyst-x64;maccatalyst-arm64</RuntimeIdentifiers> -->

		<OutputType>Exe</OutputType>
		<RootNamespace>Asistente</RootNamespace>
		<UseMaui>true</UseMaui>
		<SingleProject>true</SingleProject>
		<ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
		<Nullable>enable</Nullable>

		<!-- Enable XAML source generation for faster build times and improved performance.
		     This generates C# code from XAML at compile time instead of runtime inflation.
		     To disable, remove this line.
		     For individual files, you can override by setting Inflator metadata:
		       <MauiXaml Update="MyPage.xaml" Inflator="Default" /> (reverts to defaults: Runtime for Debug, XamlC for Release)
		       <MauiXaml Update="MyPage.xaml" Inflator="Runtime" /> (force runtime inflation) -->
		<MauiXamlInflator>SourceGen</MauiXamlInflator>

		<!-- Display name -->
		<ApplicationTitle>Asistente</ApplicationTitle>

		<!-- App Identifier -->
		<ApplicationId>com.companyname.asistente</ApplicationId>

		<!-- Versions -->
		<ApplicationDisplayVersion>1.1</ApplicationDisplayVersion>
		<ApplicationVersion>2</ApplicationVersion>

		<!-- To develop, package, and publish an app to the Microsoft Store, see: https://aka.ms/MauiTemplateUnpackaged -->
		<WindowsPackageType>None</WindowsPackageType>

		<SupportedOSPlatformVersion Condition="$([MSBuild]::GetTargetPlatformIdentifier('$(TargetFramework)')) == 'ios'">15.0</SupportedOSPlatformVersion>
		<SupportedOSPlatformVersion Condition="$([MSBuild]::GetTargetPlatformIdentifier('$(TargetFramework)')) == 'maccatalyst'">15.0</SupportedOSPlatformVersion>
		<SupportedOSPlatformVersion Condition="$([MSBuild]::GetTargetPlatformIdentifier('$(TargetFramework)')) == 'android'">21.0</SupportedOSPlatformVersion>
		<SupportedOSPlatformVersion Condition="$([MSBuild]::GetTargetPlatformIdentifier('$(TargetFramework)')) == 'windows'">10.0.17763.0</SupportedOSPlatformVersion>
		<TargetPlatformMinVersion Condition="$([MSBuild]::GetTargetPlatformIdentifier('$(TargetFramework)')) == 'windows'">10.0.17763.0</TargetPlatformMinVersion>
	</PropertyGroup>

	<ItemGroup>
		<!-- App Icon -->
		<MauiIcon Include="Resources\AppIcon\appicon.png"
				  ForegroundFile="Resources\AppIcon\appiconfg.png"
				  Color="#FFFFFF"
				  ForegroundScale="0.65"
				  BaseSize="512,512" />

		<!-- Logo mostrable dentro de la app (Login / Register).
		     Se usa appiconfg.png porque es la version con canal alfa: el glifo es
		     azul marino sobre fondo transparente, mientras appicon.png es un cuadro
		     blanco opaco que solo sirve como capa de fondo del icono del lanzador. -->
		<MauiImage Include="Resources\AppIcon\appiconfg.png" Resize="True" BaseSize="256,256" />
		
		<!-- Splash Screen -->
		<MauiSplashScreen Include="Resources\Splash\splash.svg" Color="#172554" BaseSize="128,128" />

		<!-- Images -->
		<MauiImage Include="Resources\Images\*" />
		<MauiImage Update="Resources\Images\dotnet_bot.png" Resize="True" BaseSize="300,185" />
		
		<!-- Custom Fonts -->
		<MauiFont Include="Resources\Fonts\*" />

		<!-- Raw Assets (also remove the "Resources\Raw" prefix) -->
		<MauiAsset Include="Resources\Raw\**" LogicalName="%(RecursiveDir)%(Filename)%(Extension)" />
	</ItemGroup>

	<ItemGroup>
		<PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Maui.Controls" Version="$(MauiVersion)" />
		<PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Debug" Version="10.0.0" />
		<PackageReference Include="Plugin.LocalNotification" Version="14.1.1" />
		<PackageReference Include="sqlite-net-pcl" Version="1.11.285" />
		<PackageReference Include="Supabase" Version="8.0.0" />
	</ItemGroup>

	<!-- Solo Windows: icono en la bandeja del sistema. Mantiene el proceso vivo
	     al cerrar la ventana para que los recordatorios sigan saliendo. -->
	<ItemGroup Condition="$([MSBuild]::GetTargetPlatformIdentifier('$(TargetFramework)')) == 'windows'">
		<PackageReference Include="H.NotifyIcon.WinUI" Version="2.4.1" />
	</ItemGroup>

	<ItemGroup>
	  <MauiXaml Update="LoginPage.xaml">
	    <Generator>MSBuild:Compile</Generator>
	  </MauiXaml>
	  <MauiXaml Update="RegisterPage.xaml">
	    <Generator>MSBuild:Compile</Generator>
	  </MauiXaml>
	</ItemGroup>

</Project>
